shifts_rate_matches_tier.name: shifts_rate_matches_tier
shifts_rate_matches_tier.value:
("shifts"."shift_tier" = 'BGAY_HOME_300' AND "shifts"."gross_rate" = 300 AND "shifts"."caregiver_payout" = 240 AND "shifts"."platform_margin" = 60)
       OR ("shifts"."shift_tier" = 'CVMC_INSTITUTIONAL_500' AND "shifts"."gross_rate" = 500 AND "shifts"."caregiver_payout" = 400 AND "shifts"."platform_margin" = 100)

shifts_clock_order.name: shifts_clock_order
shifts_clock_order.value: "shifts"."clock_out" IS NULL OR ("shifts"."clock_in" IS NOT NULL AND "shifts"."clock_out" >= "shifts"."clock_in")

users_contact_required.name: users_contact_required
users_contact_required.value: "users"."phone_number" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."email" IS NOT NULL
